# Customer Survey Design

`customer-survey-design` · v1.1.0 · Diagnose · Research & Personas
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/customer-survey-design/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** How many responses do we need, and which segment cuts will our sample be able to read?

**Inputs:** The decision the survey should inform, who you'll ask, audience size and expected response rate if known, and the segment cuts you plan to report

**Output:** A structured survey — questions, types, scales, and order — designed to avoid bias, plus required completes, invites, and a per-segment readability verdict from the engine

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill customer-survey-design`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/customer-survey-design/resources/survey-design.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/customer-survey-design/resources/survey-design.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It sizes the sample, not the questions. It cannot spot leading or double-barrelled wording; pilot the survey with a few people first.
- Invites are completes divided by the response rate you enter. An optimistic rate makes an infeasible plan look feasible.
- Segment margins are worst case per cell, and the READ, CAUTION and DON'T READ cut-offs (5 and 8 points) are working labels, not laws.
- It sizes survey reads, not experiments. Whether variant B beat variant A belongs in ab-test-significance.

**Review before acting:** The founder or researcher confirms the reachable audience size and a response rate from past sends, and drops or resizes any DON'T READ segment before the readout promises it.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/customer-survey-design](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/customer-survey-design)
